description: Breaking (A 550 1, A 512 2) on a multi-block grid: the wavy channel of 144 x 12 cells as three blocks in a row (blocks 1 and 2 turned by 180 deg in their indices), a 0.35 m dam break with its step at the interface of blocks 0 and 2 (F 72), so that the bore breaks on both sides of the interface. The ring of block 0 and the cells around the blocks take the detection, the flags and the breaking viscosity of the cells they stand for: the blocks break as one grid (Dropbox validation 05_block_breaking: 1e-4 m/s from one block after 0.2 s, 4e-2 m/s without the exchange).
covers: nhflow_breaking::brk_defer on block 0 and the blocks 1..
